MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels like a useful next purchase because it would let my recently purchased Echo devices control something else in my home.",
    "The Blink bundle interests me because it builds on my earlier door alarm purchase and works with the Alexa devices I already have."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "An older Echo Dot or Fire TV Stick adds little for me after buying a fourth-generation Dot and a Fire TV Stick 4K Max; those purchases already cover those needs.",
    "Headphones, a calling headset, a tablet, and car Alexa do not address a current need just because I have bought computer accessories and Alexa devices.",
    "The larger Echo Show and portable speaker fit past interests, but I would pass now because I recently bought a Show 5 and have no clear need for another speaker."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My recent Alexa purchases seem to be treated as a reason to want any Alexa device, even when it duplicates something I just bought or serves a different setting.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to imply interest in more gadgets generally, when I usually need a specific practical reason to add one."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show which needs I have already filled, especially for smart speakers, displays, and streaming devices.",
    "Buying a stand for my Show 5 and replacement batteries for my Harmony remote suggests that useful additions to equipment I own can appeal more than another standalone device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in Alexa and home electronics, but miss that I currently value useful extensions to my setup more than duplicate devices or unrelated gadgets."
}
